events.description:

Presented by Ness Creek Music Festival.

C.O.L.A. is sort of a self-titled album. It’s an acronym for Cost of Living Adjustment, a fitting conceptual framework for the band’s third record. Why? Because C.O.L.A. considers, among other things, socialism vs. hell. It considers: rolling the dice of life. The eerie and sweet pangs that nostalgia can provoke. Cola, as a band, is defined by its “tasteful minimalism.” A deep appreciation for making music that is romantic, subtle, and deceptively intense.

Gizmo are Charlottetown rockers inspired by the guitar-damaged pop of 1990s American slacker bands and their contemporaries on Canada’s East Coast. A 120 Minutes band for the Gen Z set, they breathe new life into their vintage influences with a distinctive songwriting style and a frenetic live show.

Formed in Saskatoon SK in July 2022 doing some Girlschool covers at local watering hole Black Cat Tavern, Lucy’s Seduction are some solid rock’n roll toilet action come to life and ready to spray their brown riffage all over unsuspecting audiences. Imagine L7, Hole and Motorhead spitting glass and crashing through storefront windows, chased by sirens. Consisting of Brianne Jonsson (guitar/vocals), Cassandra Lavoie (bass/vocals), Shelby Gaudet (guitar/vocals) and James McKnight (drums), Lucy’s are here for the good times, and all creeps and bummers can take a hike.

events.title: Big Band Theory 5! | Winterruption
events.description: The Big Band Theory V: Five Years of Musical Momentum celebrates the fifth anniversary of this unique annual gathering of Saskatoon's premier big band jazz ensembles. Bringing together the University of Saskatchewan Jazz Ensemble, the Saskatoon Jazz Orchestra, the Stone Frigate Big Band, and the Footnotes Big Band, this special jazz concert within the Braodway Theatres Winteruption Festival showcases the power, energy, and enduring appeal of big band jazz. events.title: Winterruption 2027 Close Out Party: Blue Hawaii, Bloodwork
events.description:
19+ w/ valid ID

Presented by Ness Creek Music Festival.

A duo skilled at turning heartache and separation into danceable electronic alt-pop, Blue Hawaii is Raphaelle Standell and Alexander Kirby Cowan. Their sound waivers between an underground, emotional introspection and club ready hyperpop. They are based in Montreal and Berlin and combine those influences as a blend of European dance music with R&B/pop vocals to create a distinctly carefree sound, especially energetic and fun live, resonating with queer communities everywhere.

Bloodwork is a Saskatoon-based producer who’s crate-digging has led to the perfect blend of rainy day hip-hop beats and dark, cinematic pop. Pulling samples from sources like J-Pop, French garage rock, grandma’s old gospel recordings, and lost TV shows, Bloodwork’s debut album, I Went Back in Time to Save You, creates an unforgettable soundscape akin to DJ Shadow, Madlib, El-P. and The Avalanches.

events.description:
Showtime: 7:30PM.
DEREK EDWARDS - Oxy Moron
Every few millennia, a comic emerges, born from the cosmic soup of fate and time, jostled by the gales of change onto the unpredictable shores of comedic brilliance. This is a man who embodies pluck and wit, lighthearted yet encumbered, and a naivete that somehow remains endearing. As Derek says: In the grand contest of life, he stands proudly as a bona fide “participant.”
Well ... truth be told, there’s a lot more to it than that. From Vegas to St. John's, this Just For Laughs veteran is universally considered to be among the comic elite. Certainly his peers think so, as evidenced by the fact that he's a four-time nominee, and winner of Best Standup Comic - Canadian Comedy Awards, as well as a multiple Gemini nominee for Best Performance in a Comedy. As Rick Mercer says, “Everyone knows Derek is the funniest man in Canada.”

events.title: RUMOURS: The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac Tribute Show
events.description:
Doors: 7PM. Showtime 7:30PM.
RUMOURS, The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac Tribute Show

VaughnCo Entertainment is proud to present “Rumours” The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac tribute show based in Los Angeles, California. The group recreates the legendary band in its youthful heyday from 1975-1979. “It’s been said imitation is the sincerest form of flattery. I say THANK YOU!”- Richard Dashut Record Producer - Fleetwood Mac albums including Rumours, Tusk, Live Mirage, Tango In The Night, and Time.

After finding huge success in Los Angeles, selling out their regular Roxy Theatre performances month after month, the band moved from the world famous Sunset Strip to Casinos, Theatres, and clubs all over Canada and the United States.

Rumours has meticulously put together a show that spares no detail. From period accurate equipment and costumes to spot on characterizations and musical performances, “Rumours" takes you back to a time when music was still an unbridled cultural experience, and bands weren't afraid to put on a show.

Relive the rock and roll magic with “Rumours” The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac Tribute Show!

sources.name: Amigos Cantina – Events & Concerts
sources.notes: Official WordPress events list with per-event pages (description, age, ticket links). robots.txt allows all.

sources.name: Amigos Cantina – Ticket site
sources.notes: Venue's own ticketing site (same platform as Broadway Theatre). Supplies ticket prices.

sources.name: Black Cat Tavern – Events calendar
sources.notes: Events are loaded client-side by an Elfsight Event Calendar widget. The adapter reads the widget's public JSON (the same data the page loads), so no HTML scraping is needed. The widget also lists shows the venue's promoters run at Louis' and Coors Event Centre; these are mapped to those venues, not to Black Cat.

sources.name: Broadway Theatre – Events
sources.notes: Server-rendered list with titles, dates, times, venue, starting prices and posters.

sources.name: AllEvents – Capitol (Saskatoon)
sources.notes: schema.org Event JSON-LD embedded in the page. Discovery only, never treated as venue confirmation.

sources.name: AllEvents – Saskatoon music
sources.notes: Additional AllEvents Saskatoon category page, expected to use the same JSON-LD format as the Capitol page. URL pattern assumed, not confirmed by hand; the ingest report shows whether it yields events.

sources.name: Sneakers & Lipstick – Weekend event guide
sources.notes: Saskatoon lifestyle blog (Squarespace). No calendar or feed: events are written up in blog posts, mainly the weekly weekend guide. The adapter reads that post plus the newest posts in the 'saskatoon events' category. Strong on family, market and community events. Tier 4: discovery only, never venue confirmation.

sources.name: Art Bar – Main Stage calendar (Jump Comedy ticketing)
sources.notes: artbartheatre.com is a GoDaddy site with no event markup of its own. Its Main Stage page embeds two Jump Comedy (jumpblvd.com) event-list widgets (ids 8 and 9, same shows) that load public JSON from amplify.jumpcomedy.com/store/widgets/<id>: one product per show, each showtime with local start time, prices (regular and early bird) and stock. The adapter reads that JSON; robots.txt there only disallows /e/mau1/. Ticket link is the Jump Comedy event page unless the venue names another seller (Showpass, Eventbrite). Age is the venue's stated 19+ policy. The FOH page (open mics) has no event widget.

sources.name: Bandsintown – Saskatoon
sources.notes: City page embeds schema.org MusicEvent JSON-LD. robots.txt allows generic crawlers on /c/. Official Bandsintown API is artist-scoped and needs an app_id agreement, so there is no city-wide API option. Page is behind Cloudflare and may block datacenter IPs; failures are recorded, not hidden.

sources.name: Songkick – Saskatoon metro area
sources.notes: Each listing has MusicEvent JSON-LD with venue geo and performer profiles. Songkick's partner API is closed to new applicants, so the public page's structured data is the permitted path. robots.txt allows metro-area pages for generic agents.

sources.name: Ticketmaster Discovery API (Saskatoon area)
sources.notes: Official API, free key from developer.ticketmaster.com. Covers SaskTel Centre / TCU Place arena and theatre shows. Skipped (status=needs_api_key) until the TICKETMASTER_API_KEY repository secret is set.

sources.name: Saskatoon Public Library events (iCal)
sources.notes: SPL uses Communico (libnet.info), whose event pages expose 'Add to Calendar' data in America/Regina time. The exact public feed URL was not confirmed during research, so the source is disabled until a feed URL is verified.

sources.name: SaskMusic – Live Music Listings
sources.notes: Province-wide listing with many smaller Saskatoon venues (Somewhere Else, Coors, Finns Pub @ Parktown). Markup not yet inspected; candidate for the next adapter.

sources.name: Tourism Saskatoon – Events calendar
sources.notes: Strong for non-music events (markets, tours, museums, family, sports). Markup not yet inspected; candidate adapter.

sources.name: Showpass (Capitol Music Club, Black Cat, Amigos ticketing)
sources.notes: Showpass exposes a public JSON discovery API used by its widgets. Venue filtering was not verified, so it is disabled for now. Would add Capitol Music Club prices and age limits.

sources.name: Eventbrite – The Bassment organizer
sources.notes: The Bassment sells all tickets on Eventbrite. The Eventbrite API needs a private token; Songkick already lists most Bassment shows.

sources.name: Facebook venue pages
sources.notes: Not integrated. Facebook's Graph API no longer gives third parties access to public Page events, and scraping is prohibited. The app shows Facebook event links when a venue's own listing supplies them (e.g. Amigos RSVP links).
